entities.name: Jon
entities.description: One of the two speakers. A banker who lost his job on 19 January 2023 and spent the rest of the year trying to start a dance studio of his own. He has danced since childhood and calls it his passion, his escape and his stress-buster; contemporary is his favourite style. He rehearsed with a small dance crew after work, reads business books, keeps a whiteboard and a notebook of goals, and leans heavily on his friend Gina for encouragement.

entities.name: Gina
entities.description: The other speaker. She lost her job at Door Dash in January 2023 and built a clothing business of her own — a store she designed herself and an online store that opened in March 2023 — and was accepted for a part-time fashion internship in May 2023. She competed in dance as a teenager, winning regionals at fifteen, calls dance her stress relief and contemporary her favourite style, and is Jon's steadiest supporter.

entities.name: Jon's dance studio
entities.description: The dance studio Jon set out to start after losing his banking job in January 2023, and the subject of most of what he says. He hunted premises through the spring, liked a downtown space with good natural light and wanted Marley flooring; he speaks of teaching students, running classes, workshops and one-on-one mentoring from February 2023 onward, and set the official opening night for 20 June 2023. By 21 July 2023 he called it tenuous and was looking for investors while holding a temporary job. Referred to as 'the studio', 'my dance studio' and 'my biz'.

properties.aliases: the studio; my dance studio; my biz

entities.name: Gina's clothing store
entities.description: Gina's clothing business. She ran an advertising campaign for it in January 2023, designed its interior herself with comfortable furniture and a chandelier, signed a wholesaler in February, worked with a local artist on designs, and opened it online in March 2023. Later she ran offers and promotions, added dance-inspired items, made a limited-edition line in June 2023 and built an ordering website in July 2023. Referred to as 'my store', 'my clothing store' and 'my online clothing store'.

properties.aliases: my store; my clothing store; my online clothing store; the online store

entities.name: Door Dash
entities.description: The company Gina worked for until she lost her job there in January 2023. That loss is what she says pushed her into starting her own clothing business and becoming an entrepreneur.

entities.name: dancing
entities.description: The thing Jon and Gina have in common and return to in almost every session. Both call it their stress relief, both danced and competed when they were younger, and both say they could not do without it. It is the basis of Jon's studio and of the dance-inspired items Gina sells. Referred to as 'dance' and 'dancing'.

entities.name: contemporary dance
entities.description: The dance style both Jon and Gina name as their favourite — Jon calls it expressive and powerful, Gina expressive and graceful. It is the style of 'Finding Freedom', the piece Gina's team won regionals with, and one of the styles Jon's dance crew performs alongside hip-hop.

entities.name: Jon's dance crew
entities.description: The small group of dancers Jon rehearsed with after work. They took first place at a local competition in 2022, perform everything from contemporary to hip-hop, and were finishing choreography in January 2023 for a nearby festival that Jon performed at in early February. Referred to as 'my dance crew' and 'a small group of dancers'.

properties.aliases: my dance crew; a small group of dancers

entities.name: Jon's dance students
entities.description: A group rather than an individual: the dancers Jon speaks of teaching at his studio, never named one by one. He describes them as dancers of all ages and levels, including young dancers, says watching them progress and succeed is what motivates him, and offers them classes, workshops and one-on-one mentoring and training. Referred to as 'my students', 'our young dancers' and 'the dancers'.

properties.aliases: my students; our young dancers; the dancers

entities.name: Paris
entities.description: The city Jon visited on 28 January 2023 and described as 'sooo cool'. Gina has never had the chance to go.

entities.name: Rome
entities.description: The one foreign city Gina says she has visited, once, as of January 2023. Jon took a short trip there in the week before 19 June 2023 to clear his head while working on his business.

entities.name: Finding Freedom
entities.description: The contemporary piece Gina's team performed to take first place at a regional competition when she was fifteen. She remembers it as really emotional and powerful, and it is her favourite memory of competing.

entities.name: Gina's tattoo
entities.description: A tattoo Gina got a few years before February 2023, inspired by a quote about fear that kept her positive through hard times. It stands for freedom — dancing without worrying what other people think — and reminds her to follow her passions and express herself.

entities.name: The Lean Startup
entities.description: The business book Jon was reading in May 2023, hoping it would give him tips for his business. It got him thinking about building a focused and efficient business and about adapting and tweaking from customer feedback, which he said he would try.

entities.name: Jon's whiteboard
entities.description: The whiteboard on which Jon tracks his ideas, milestones and dates. He colour-codes achievements on it so he can see progress at a glance, and says it gives him a visual picture of where he is and keeps him organised and motivated.

entities.name: Shia LaBeouf
entities.description: The actor Gina credited on 23 July 2023 with the 'Just do it' motivational speech she quoted at Jon to spur him on. He takes no part in the conversation; he is named only as the source of the quote.

claims.text: Jon's dance studio went from an idea announced the day after he lost his banking job in January 2023, through months of searching for premises, to an official opening night set for 20 June 2023 — and by 21 July 2023 it was on tenuous ground, with Jon holding a temporary job to cover expenses while he hunted investors.

claims.text: Gina's year went from losing her job at Door Dash in January 2023, to opening her online clothing store in March 2023, to being accepted for a part-time fashion internship at an international company in May 2023, to being noticed by fashion editors in early July 2023.
